item.title: [Breaking] Blue House recommends resignation of Lee Byung-tae… "Situation very serious" ([속보] 청와대, 이병태에 사퇴 권고… “사안 매우 엄중”)
item.description:
[Breaking] Blue House recommends resignation of Lee Byung-tae… "Situation very serious" ([속보] 청와대, 이병태에 사퇴 권고… “사안 매우 엄중”)

The Blue House announced on the 6th that it has recommended the resignation of Lee Byung-tae, vice-chairman of the Regulatory Reform Committee under the direct control of the president. (청와대가 이병태 대통령 직속 규제합리화위원회 부위원장에게 사퇴를 권고했다고 6일 밝혔다.)

This is because Vice-Chairman Lee sparked controversy by commenting, "The May 18 Democratization Movement has become a sanctuary," in relation to the so-called 'Starbucks cheer slogan' incident involving Baejae High School's baseball team. (이 부위원장이 배재고 야구부의 이른바 ‘스타벅스 응원 구호’ 논란에 “5·18이 성역이 됐다”고 발언한 것과 관련해 논란을 일으킨 탓이다.)

A Blue House official stated through a media notice on the same day, "The Blue House emphasized that as key members appointed to a presidential committee with significant responsibilities and authority, they must strive to align with the government's national policy direction, and implemented a warning measure." (청와대 관계자는 이날 언론 공지를 통해 “청와대는 책임과 권한이 큰 대통령 직속 위원회에 임명된 주요 구성원으로서 정부의 국정 기조에 부합하기 위해 노력해야 함을 강조하고, 경고 조치를 시행했다”고 했다.)

He further explained, "Since the matter was deemed very serious afterward, we recommended Vice-Chairman Lee's resignation, and he is currently assessing his own position." (또 “이후 사안이 매우 엄중한 까닭에 이 부위원장의 사퇴를 권고했고, 이에 이 부위원장이 스스로 거취를 판단하는 중”이라고 설명했다.)

He also emphasized, "The Lee Jae-myung administration will continue its efforts toward inclusiveness, expanding its reach beyond conservatives and progressives." (이어 “이재명 정부는 보수와 진보를 넘어 외연을 확장하는 포용의 노력을 지속해 나갈 것”이라고 강조했다.)

item.title: President Lee Tells PM Han, Who Reported on 'Four Key Tasks', "Take Full Authority to Lead National Innovation" (李대통령, ‘4대 역점 과제’ 보고한 韓총리에 “전권 갖고 국정 혁신 이끌어 달라”)
item.description:
President Lee Tells PM Han, Who Reported on 'Four Key Tasks', "Take Full Authority to Lead National Innovation" (李대통령, ‘4대 역점 과제’ 보고한 韓총리에 “전권 갖고 국정 혁신 이끌어 달라”)

New Prime Minister Han Seong-sook reported to President Lee Jae-myung on the 6th that, as Prime Minister, she would focus on four key areas: an 'AI (Artificial Intelligence) transformation', 'regulatory rationalization', 'a startup renaissance', and 'enhancing youth policies'. President Lee Jae-myung instructed, "Take full authority as Prime Minister and lead fundamental innovation across all state affairs." (한성숙 신임 국무총리가 6일 이재명 대통령에게 총리로서 ‘AI(인공지능) 대전환’과 ‘규제 합리화’ ‘창업 르네상스’ ‘청년 정책 내실화’ 등 네 가지 사항에 힘을 쏟겠다고 보고했다. 이재명 대통령은 “총리가 전권을 갖고, 국정 전반에 걸쳐 근본적인 혁신을 이끌어 달라”고 주문했다.)

According to the Prime Minister's Office, PM Han held her first weekly report meeting with President Lee, combined with lunch, at the Presidential Office (Cheong Wa Dae) on this day, since taking office on the 1st. (총리실에 따르면, 한 총리는 이날 청와대에서 지난 1일 총리 취임 후 처음으로 이 대통령과 오찬을 겸한 주례 보고 회동을 했다.)

The weekly report meeting is a regular session where the President and Prime Minister meet each week to share their understanding of the overall state of national affairs and current issues, and to discuss the direction of government operations. It is typically held every Monday at the Presidential Office, accompanied by lunch. The Chief of Staff to the President, the Director of National Affairs, and from the Prime Minister's Office, the Minister of the Office for Government Policy Coordination, attend. At this meeting, the Head of the Policy Office and the Head of the National Security Office from the Presidential Office also attended. (주례 보고 회동은 대통령과 총리가 매주 정례적으로 만나 국정 전반의 상황과 현안에 대한 인식을 공유하고 정부 운영 방향을 협의하는 자리로, 통상적으로 매주 월요일 청와대에서 오찬과 함께 진행된다. 청와대에서 대통령비서실장과 국정상황실장, 총리실에서 국무조정실장이 배석한다. 이번 회동에는 청와대 정책실장과 국가안보실장도 배석했다.)

PM Han reported to President Lee that she would set the AI transformation, regulatory rationalization, startup renaissance, and enhancement of youth policies as her 'Four Key Prime Ministerial Agenda Items'. (한 총리는 이 대통령에게 AI 대전환과 규제 합리화, 창업 르네상스, 청년 정책 내실화를 ‘총리 4대 역점 어젠다’로 삼겠다고 보고했다.)

President Lee expressed trust in PM Han's expertise in the IT (Information Technology) field and her experience in private-sector innovation, and emphasized, "As Prime Minister with full authority, please lead fundamental innovation not only in the way the public service operates but also across all state affairs, including regulatory rationalization, startups, and youth policies." (이 대통령은 한 총리의 IT(정보기술) 분야 전문성과 민간 혁신 경험에 대한 신뢰를 표하고, “총리가 전권을 갖고 공직사회의 일하는 방식뿐만 아니라 규제 합리화, 창업, 청년 정책 등 국정 전반에 걸쳐 근본적인 혁신을 이끌어 달라”고 강조했다.)

PM Han also reported on 'Measures to protect citizens' lives based on AI and data'. (한 총리는 ‘AI·데이터 기반 국민 생명 보호 방안’도 보고했다.)

In response, President Lee instructed, "Prepare groundbreaking measures that can protect and save citizens' lives through technology and pursue them swiftly." (이에 대해 이 대통령은 “기술로 국민의 생명을 지키고 살릴 수 있는 획기적인 방안을 마련해 신속히 추진하라”고 지시했다.)

The Prime Minister's Office stated, "President Lee and PM Han decided to continue inspecting and discussing key national issues, centering on the weekly report meetings, and to cooperate closely to generate national achievements." (총리실은 “이 대통령과 한 총리는 앞으로도 주례 보고 회동을 중심으로 주요 국정 현안을 점검·논의하고, 국정 성과 창출을 위해 긴밀히 협력해 나가기로 했다”고 전했다.)

item.title: [Breaking] Lee Byung-tae, Vice Chairman of the Regulation Rationalization Committee, Resigns Amid Controversy Over '5·18 Sanctuary' Remarks ([속보] 이병태 규제합리화부위원장, ‘5·18 성역' 논란으로 사퇴)
item.description:
[Breaking] Lee Byung-tae, Vice Chairman of the Regulation Rationalization Committee, Resigns Amid Controversy Over '5·18 Sanctuary' Remarks ([속보] 이병태 규제합리화부위원장, ‘5·18 성역' 논란으로 사퇴)

The Blue House announced on the 6th that Vice Chairman Lee Byung-tae of the Regulation Rationalization Committee, who sparked controversy by criticizing Baejae High School's baseball team's "Starbucks cheering song" with the question "Is 5·18 a sanctuary?", has expressed his intention to resign, and this has been accepted. (청와대는 6일 배재고 야구부의 ‘스타벅스 응원가’에 대해 ‘5·18이 성역인가’라고 비판해 논란이 된 이병태 규제합리화위원회 부위원장이 사퇴 의사를 밝혔고, 이를 수용했다고 밝혔다.)

Despite repeated calls for his resignation from the ruling party, Vice Chairman Lee had not previously indicated his intention to step down. However, after the Blue House issued a statement that afternoon recommending his resignation, he conveyed his decision to voluntarily resign. (이 부위원장은 여권의 잇따른 사퇴 요구에도 사퇴 의사를 밝히지 않았지만, 이날 오후 청와대가 “이 부위원장의 사퇴를 권고했다”는 입장을 내자 자진 사퇴 의사를 전한 것이다.)

item.title: Rep. Kim Hyun-jung of the Democratic Party: "Three Mega Projects, Parliamentary Investigation? Special Counsel? Stop the Hyena Politics of the People Power Party" (與 김현정 “3대 메가 프로젝트 국정조사? 특검? 국힘 하이에나 정치 그만두길”)
item.description:
Rep. Kim Hyun-jung of the Democratic Party: "Three Mega Projects, Parliamentary Investigation? Special Counsel? Stop the Hyena Politics of the People Power Party" (與 김현정 “3대 메가 프로젝트 국정조사? 특검? 국힘 하이에나 정치 그만두길”)

Rep. Kim Hyun-jung of the Democratic Party of Korea strongly criticized Rep. Na Kyung-won of the People Power Party for criticizing the plan to create the Honam Semiconductor National Industrial Complex, calling her the "vanguard of Honam hatred" and engaging in "hyena-style politics." (더불어민주당 김현정 의원이 호남 반도체 국가산업단지 조성 계획 등을 비판한 국민의힘 나경원 의원을 향해 “호남 혐오의 선봉장” “하이에나식 정치”라고 강하게 비판했다.)

In a Facebook post today, Rep. Kim stated, "They are degrading a future industry that should be discussed over 20 to 30 years of the nation's time as a 'show for a party convention' and insulting the opportunities of Honam youth as 'vote-seeking.'" (김 의원은 이날 자신의 페이스북에 “국가의 20년, 30년을 걸고 논의해야 할 미래 산업을 ‘전당대회용 쇼’로 깎아내리고 호남 청년들의 기회를 ‘표몰이’라고 모욕했다”고 했다.)

She continued, "When corporate heads are summoned to discuss future strategies, they call it a 'prop' or a 'rip-off show,' and when long-term investments are promised, they twist it into 'investments forced by pressure' and attack it. Can national strategy be degraded this much unless it is hyena politics, constantly searching for tomorrow's headlines?" (이어 “기업 총수들을 불러 미래 전략을 논의하면 ‘들러리’, ‘갈취 쇼’라고 하고, 장기 투자를 약속하면 ‘압박에 떠밀린 투자’라고 뒤틀어 공격한다”며 “내일의 기사거리만 찾아 헤매는 하이에나 정치가 아니고서야 국가 전략을 이렇게까지 깎아내릴 수 있느냐”고 비판했다.)

Regarding Rep. Na's mention of a parliamentary investigation and special counsel, Rep. Kim said, "This is merely a call to waste administrative capacity through wasteful political strife. It is not worth paying attention to any longer." (김 의원은 나 의원이 국정조사와 특검을 거론한 데 대해서도 “소모적 정쟁으로 행정력을 낭비하자는 이야기일 뿐”이라며 “더 이상 들어줄 가치도 없다”고 했다.)

On the other hand, regarding the remarks of former Rep. Lee Jung-hyun, a member of the People Power Party, she said, "In relation to the Honam semiconductor debate, former Rep. Lee stated, 'The underdevelopment and neglect of Honam is not just a problem for Honam, but a problem for the Republic of Korea, and I hope the conservatives will take this issue to heart first.' In that one sentence, I saw what dignified conservatism is." (반면 국민의힘 소속인 이정현 전 의원의 발언에 대해선 “이 전 의원은 호남 반도체 논쟁과 관련해 ‘호남의 낙후와 소외는 호남만의 문제가 아니라 대한민국의 문제이며, 보수가 이 일을 먼저 품었으면 좋겠다’고 말했다”며 “이 한마디에서 품격 있는 보수가 무엇인지 봤다”고 밝혔다.)

She then asserted, "While one side of the conservatives talks about affection for Honam and the future of the Republic of Korea, Rep. Na is caught up in fear and jealousy over Honam's potential development, using even the future of the nation and businesses as fuel for political strife." (그러면서 “보수의 한쪽에서는 호남을 향한 애정과 대한민국의 미래를 이야기하는 반면, 나 의원은 호남이 발전할 것 같은 두려움과 질투에 사로잡혀 국가와 기업의 미래까지 정쟁의 불쏘시개로 삼고 있다”고 주장했다.)

Rep. Kim concluded, "Just by comparing former Rep. Lee Jung-hyun and Rep. Na Kyung-won, the people can see which type of conservatism the Republic of Korea needs and which type of politics represents outdated politics that deserve to be judged. I recommend that Rep. Na stop her low-grade hyena politics and learn from former Rep. Lee what conservatism truly is." (김 의원은 “이정현 전 의원과 나경원 의원의 대비만으로도 어떤 보수가 대한민국에 필요한지, 어떤 정치가 심판받아야 할 낡은 정치인지 국민은 보고 있다”며 “나 의원은 저급한 하이에나 정치를 그만두고 이 전 의원에게 보수가 무엇인지 배우길 권고한다”고 했다.)

item.title: [Breaking] Presidential Office: "Honam Semiconductor Cluster to Be Built on Gwangju Air Base Site" ([속보] 靑 “호남 반도체 클러스터, 광주 군공항 부지에 조성”)
item.description:
[Breaking] Presidential Office: "Honam Semiconductor Cluster to Be Built on Gwangju Air Base Site" ([속보] 靑 “호남 반도체 클러스터, 광주 군공항 부지에 조성”)

Presidential Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik announced on the 6th that the Honam region semiconductor cluster, promoted as part of the "three major mega projects," has been decided to be built on the site of Gwangju Air Base. (강훈식 대통령 비서실장은 6일 ‘3대 메가 프로젝트’ 일환으로 추진하는 호남권 반도체 클러스터를 광주 군공항 부지에 조성하기로 결정했다고 밝혔다.)

During a briefing after a public-private joint inspection meeting for the promotion of the three major mega projects held at the presidential office, Chief Kang said, "Regarding semiconductor investment in the Honam region, we discussed the first step, which is the site," adding, "Companies expressed that among the candidate locations in the Honam region, the Gwangju Air Base area is the most suitable." Previously, Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix announced plans to invest 800 trillion won to build four semiconductor fabs (factories) in the Honam region. (강 실장은 이날 청와대에서 3대 메가 프로젝트 추진을 위한 민관 합동 점검 회의를 가진 뒤 브리핑에서 “호남권 반도체 투자와 관련해 그 첫 단계인 부지 관련해 논의했다”며 “기업들은 호남권 입지 후보지 중에 광주 군공항 지역이 가장 적합하다는 의견을 제시했다”고 말했다. 앞서 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스는 800조원을 투자해 호남에 반도체 팹(fab·공장) 4기를 건설하겠다고 밝혔다.)

Chief Kang stated, "The Gwangju Air Base area can secure a site of about 2.5 million pyeong (approximately 8.26 square kilometers), and due to its nature as an airfield, the land has already been leveled, which has the advantage of minimizing the site preparation period." He added, "It is adjacent to downtown Gwangju and the KTX station, offering strengths in securing personnel and living conditions, and it also has excellent logistics accessibility connected to roads, airports, and ports. Accordingly, at today's meeting, we decided to create a Honam semiconductor industrial complex on the Gwangju Air Base site." (강 실장은 “광주 군공항 지역은 약 250만평 규모의 부지 확보가 가능하고, 공항 특성상 이미 평탄화가 완료되어 있는 만큼 부지 공사 기간을 최소화할 수 있는 장점이 있다”고 했다. 이어 “광주 도심, KTX 역에 인접해 있어 인력 확보와 정주 여건 측면에서 강점이 있고 도로, 공항, 항만 등과 연계한 물류 접근성도 우수하다”며 “이에 따라 오늘 회의에서 광주 군공항 부지에 호남권 반도체 산단을 조성하기로 결정했다”고 말했다.)

Chief Kang said, "The government will swiftly complete the candidate site selection process through consultations with relevant ministries and begin subsequent procedures for the development of the industrial complex." (강 실장은 “정부는 관계 부처 협의를 거쳐 조속히 후보지 선정 절차를 마무리하고 산단 개발을 위한 후속 절차에 착수하겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] Gwangju Military Airport Designated for Semiconductor Site, Ammunition Depot Relocation Canceled... Potential Loss of 300 Billion Won ([단독] 광주군공항, 반도체 부지 지정에 탄약고 이전 무산... 3000억 날릴 듯)
item.description:
[Exclusive] Gwangju Military Airport Designated for Semiconductor Site, Ammunition Depot Relocation Canceled... Potential Loss of 300 Billion Won ([단독] 광주군공항, 반도체 부지 지정에 탄약고 이전 무산... 3000억 날릴 듯)

With the decision to develop the Honam Semiconductor National Industrial Complex on the Gwangju military airport site, the relocation project for the Mareuk-dong ammunition depot in Gwangju, pursued for over 20 years, has effectively been canceled, it has been confirmed. (광주 군공항 부지에 호남 반도체 국가산업단지를 조성하기로 결정되면서, 20년 넘게 추진돼 온 광주 마륵동 탄약고 이전 사업이 사실상 무산된 것으로 확인됐다.)

According to an official from the South Jeolla-Gwangju Integrated Special City, the Ministry of National Defense and Gwangju Metropolitan City had originally been pushing ahead with a project to move the ammunition depot in the Seo-gu Mareuk-dong and Geumho-dong area to near Gwangju military airport since 2005. The total project cost was 326.2 billion won, of which 268.1 billion won had been spent by last year, with construction planned to start next year. Representative Yang Bu-nam of the Democratic Party of Korea, the lawmaker for the district, had even promoted that 5 billion won in national budget had been secured for the 2026 budget. The new ammunition depot site had already been purchased and largely leveled. (전남광주통합특별시 관계자에 따르면, 당초 국방부와 광주광역시는 서구 마륵동·금호동 일대 탄약고를 광주 군공항 인근으로 옮기는 사업을 2005년부터 추진해왔다. 총사업비는 3262억원으로, 지난해까지 2681억원이 집행됐고 내년부터 착공될 계획이었다. 해당 지역구 의원인 더불어민주당 양부남 의원도 2026년 본예산에 50억 원의 국비 예산이 확정되었다며 홍보한 바 있다. 새 탄약고 부지는 이미 매입과 평탄화 작업까지 대부분 끝난 상태였다.)

However, the situation changed early this year when the Presidential Office and the Ministry of National Defense discussed utilizing the Gwangju military airport site for the Honam Semiconductor National Industrial Complex. This effectively requires halting the ammunition depot relocation project to make way for the semiconductor complex. It is now highly likely that the ammunition depot will be moved to an entirely new site around 10 years from now, when the Gwangju military airport is scheduled to relocate to Muan. (하지만 올해 초 청와대와 국방부가 광주 군공항 부지를 호남 반도체 국가산단으로 활용하는 방안을 논의하면서 상황이 바뀌었다. 반도체 산단 조성을 위해 탄약고 이전 사업을 사실상 중단해야 한다는 것이다. 탄약고는 광주 군공항이 무안으로 이전할 즈음인 10년 뒤 아예 새 부지로 이전할 가능성이 커졌다.)

Residents near the ammunition depot are also expected to protest. For decades, residents around the Mareuk-dong ammunition depot have been restricted in their property rights due to designation as a military facility protection zone. The Ministry of National Defense and political figures had extensively promoted budget allocations and project progress, but now complaints are arising that the change in government policy has reset the entire project back to square one. (탄약고 인근 주민들의 반발도 예상된다. 마륵동 탄약고 주변 주민들은 수십 년째 군사시설 보호구역으로 묶여 재산권 행사에 제약을 받아왔다. 그동안 국방부와 정치권도 예산 확보와 사업 추진을 대대적으로 홍보했지만, 정부 정책이 바뀌면서 사업 자체가 원점으로 돌아갔다는 불만이 나온다.)

item.title: Pro-Chung Kye Campaigners: “Why Did Kim Min-seok Skip the Vote to Lift Martial Law?” “The Height of Irresponsibility” (與 친청계 “김민석, 계엄 해제 표결 왜 불참했나” “무책임의 극치”)
item.description:
Pro-Chung Kye Campaigners: “Why Did Kim Min-seok Skip the Vote to Lift Martial Law?” “The Height of Irresponsibility” (與 친청계 “김민석, 계엄 해제 표결 왜 불참했나” “무책임의 극치”)

Lee Seong-yoon, a Supreme Council member of the Democratic Party of Korea, said on the 6th regarding former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, who declared his candidacy for party leadership, “Why didn’t you participate in the vote to lift martial law?” Lee is considered a key figure among the pro-Chung Kye faction within the party. Rep. Han Min-soo, who served as chief of staff to Representative Chung Kye, also stated, “Former Prime Minister Kim must give a clear and responsible answer to the public and party members regarding his irresponsible and self-contradictory remarks.” When Kim criticized former Representative Chung Kye in his candidacy declaration that day, the pro-Chung faction launched a unified counterattack. <<> Lee posted on Facebook that day, “After seeing former Prime Minister Kim’s declaration to run for party leadership, my first impression or thought was truly disappointing.” Regarding Kim’s reference to ‘the harmful effects of his own politics over the past year,’ Lee said, “A candidacy declaration that just blames and criticizes others is deplorable. Isn’t this precisely Kim’s own ‘harmful self-politics’ or ‘self-politics causing confusion in party-government cooperation’?” <<> Lee then brought up the phrase ‘the night of sleeplessness and determination’ from Kim’s declaration, asking, “As the entire nation knows, former Prime Minister Kim did not attend the National Assembly vote to lift Yoon Seok-youl’s martial law. Why didn’t you participate in the vote?” <<> He also said, “You claimed you were asleep after taking cold medicine—what was in that cold medicine?” He added, “There’s a saying that ‘you can wake someone who is sleeping, but you can’t wake someone pretending to sleep.’ Is that the case?” He continued, “It’s said that a Democratic Party lawmaker spoke with (former Prime Minister Kim) right before the martial law declaration. Then shouldn’t he have immediately rushed to the National Assembly?” This referred to Rep. Park Seon-won of the Democratic Party contacting Kim just before the martial law declaration. Previously, Rep. Park had explained this by saying, “There was talk that former President Yoon Seok-youl would issue a statement criticizing the Democratic Party, so I reported it via text message.” <<> Lee further stated, “(Former Prime Minister Kim) claimed that abolishing supplementary investigative powers was a consistent stance. He said he proposed the party handle reform plans containing supplementary investigative powers in May this year but that it was postponed at the party’s request. However, neither the party leader nor the floor leader says they received such a notification. Even I, as a Supreme Council member of the Democratic Party, have never discussed supplementary investigative powers at the Supreme Council.” He asked, “When and to whom did former Prime Minister Kim directly make this proposal? You can’t cover the sky with the palm of your hand. The truth will come out.” <<> Rep. Han Min-soo posted on Facebook that day targeting former Prime Minister Kim, saying, “If someone is challenging for the leadership of the ruling party, they should present a vision for the future, specific policy alternatives, and a direction, winning the hearts of party members and the public. Nevertheless, I can’t help but be disappointed to see you, from the very start of your candidacy, listing anachronistic and out-of-touch remarks.” <<> Rep. Han added, “If you’re going to point out that there was confusion, it’s common sense to present at least minimal evidence and specific examples. Are you just repeating assertions without any basis and trying to shift the blame entirely onto the party?” He continued, “Former Prime Minister Kim was the initial prime minister of the Lee Jae-myung administration, overseeing the entire cabinet and government operations. If there was indeed confusion between the party and the government, the prime minister himself can never be free from that responsibility. Yet, acting as if you were an uninvolved bystander and blaming others—isn’t that the height of irresponsibility?” <<> He stated, “This is practically an attempt to deny and belittle the entire cooperation built over a year by the party, government, and presidential office as one team and one voice, as well as the achievements of reforms in the prosecution, media, and judiciary, driven by political self-interest.” (이성윤 더불어민주당 최고위원이 6일 당대표 출마 선언을 한 김민석 전 국무총리를 향해 “계엄 해제 표결에 왜 참여하지 않았느냐”고 했다. 이 최고위원은 당내 친정청래계 주요 인사로 꼽힌다. 정청래 대표 비서실장을 지냈던 한민수 의원도 “김 전 총리는 무책임하고 자기 모순적인 발언에 대해 국민과 당원 앞에 분명하고 책임 있는 답을 내놓아야 한다”고 했다. 김 전 총리가 이날 출마 선언에서 정청래 전 대표를 비판하자 친청계에서 일제히 반격에 나선 것이다.)

item.title: Press conference on 'Integrated Military Academy to Daejeon' abruptly postponed (‘통합 사관학교 대전행’ 발표하려다… 회견 돌연 연기)
item.description:
The Ministry of National Defense abruptly postponed a briefing on the 'basic plan' for integrating the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies about 100 minutes before it was scheduled for the morning of the 6th. The Ministry explained that the schedule change was unavoidable as Defense Minister Ahn Gyu-back, who was to announce the integration plan directly, had to attend the 'Mega Project Public-Private Joint Review Meeting' at the Presidential Office that day. However, within and outside the military, there are murmurs suggesting other underlying reasons. Observations are emerging that the Ministry may have felt pressure from opposition by the alumni associations of the three service academies and critical public opinion from the opposition, alongside speculation that there are disagreements within the ruling camp over the integration plan. (국방부가 6일 오전으로 예정했던 육·해·공군 사관학교 통합 관련 ‘기본계획’ 브리핑을 약 100분 앞두고 돌연 연기했다. 국방부는 직접 통합 계획을 발표하려던 안규백 국방부 장관이 이날 청와대에서 열리는 ‘메가프로젝트 민관합동 점검회의’에 참석하게 되면서 일정 변경이 불가피했다고 설명했지만, 군 안팎에서는 다른 배경이 있는 것 아니냐는 말들도 나오고 있다. 육·해·공군 사관학교 총동창회의 반발과 야권의 비판 여론에 국방부가 부담을 느낀 것 아니냐는 관측과 여권 내에서도 사관학교 통합 방안에 이견이 있는 것 같다는 관측이 동시에 제기되고 있다.)

Minister Ahn Gyu-back was scheduled to hold a briefing at 10:30 a.m. at the Ministry of National Defense building in Yongsan-gu, Seoul, to announce the basic plan for establishing the National Military Academy. The core of the plan, as known, was to amend the Military Academy Establishment Act, which currently mandates separate academies for the Army, Navy, and Air Force, to create an integrated National Military Academy by around 2028 at Jaundae in Daejeon. (안규백 장관은 이날 오전 10시 30분 서울 용산구 국방부 청사에서 브리핑을 열고 국군사관학교 창설 기본계획을 발표할 예정이었다. 육·해·공군에 각각 사관학교를 두도록 명시한 사관학교 설치법을 고쳐, 이르면 2028년쯤 대전 자운대에 이를 통합한 국군사관학교를 창설하는 것이 그 골자로 알려졌다.)

However, the Ministry notified the postponement about 1 hour and 40 minutes before the briefing. Minister Ahn attended the 'Mega Project Public-Private Joint Review Meeting' at the Presidential Office that morning. The meeting reportedly discussed the creation of a semiconductor cluster in Honam on the site of the Gwangju Air Force Base, which likely required the Minister's urgent attendance. It is known that Minister Ahn will proceed with the briefing on the establishment of the National Military Academy after accompanying President Lee Jae-myung to the NATO summit in Ankara, Turkey, on the 7th and 8th. (하지만 국방부는 브리핑을 약 1시간 40분 앞두고 이를 순연한다고 공지했다. 안 장관은 이날 오전 청와대에서 열린 ‘메가프로젝트 민관합동 점검회의’에 참석했다. 호남 반도체 클러스터를 광주 군공항 부지에 조성한다는 내용이 논의되면서, 안 장관이 급히 회의에 참석하게 된 것으로 보인다. 안 장관은 7∼8일 튀르키예 앙카라에서 열리는 북대서양조약기구(NATO) 정상회의에 참석하는 이재명 대통령을 수행한 이후, 국군사관학교 창설 관련 브리핑을 다시 추진할 계획으로 알려졌다.)

While the Ministry's official stance is a 'scheduling issue', rumors circulated within and outside the military that there are disagreements within the ruling camp over the integration plan. Earlier, Rep. Lee Gae-ho of the Democratic Party (representing Damyang, Hampyeong, Yeonggwang, and Jangseong in South Jeolla Province) stated that he met with Defense Minister Ahn Gyu-back last month at the National Assembly and suggested relocating the Korea Military Academy (KMA) from Taereung, Seoul, to Jangseong County in South Jeolla Province. Jangseong County hosts Sangmu University, a complex housing five Army branch schools, including the Army Infantry and Artillery Schools. Conversely, the KMA Alumni Association and retired generals have expressed opposition to the relocation to Jangseong. (‘일정 문제’라는 것이 국방부의 공식 입장이지만, 군 안팎에서는 사관학교 통합 방안을 두고 여권 내에 이견이 있는 것 아니냐는 소문이 돌았다. 앞서 더불어민주당 이개호 국회의원(전남 담양·함평·영광·장성)은 지난달 국회에서 안규백 국방부 장관을 만나 서울 태릉에 있는 육군사관학교의 전남 장성군 이전을 건의했다고 밝힌 바 있다. 장성군에는 육군보병·포병학교 등 5개 육군 병과학교가 모인 상무대가 있다. 반면 육군사관학교 총동창회와 예비역 장성 등은 전남 장성 이전에 반대한다는 뜻을 밝혀 왔다.)

It is known that the basic plan Minister Ahn intended to brief on the 6th included the government's foundational concepts on education methods, in addition to the location for the new National Military Academy. This information is crucial for potential applicants interested in the academies, but its release has also been delayed. Amidst the absence of detailed plans, the joint alumni associations of the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies plan to hold a 'Rally Against Closure and Relocation of Military Academies' in front of the National Assembly main building on the 8th. As this conflict persists, controversy over the necessity of integrating the academies is growing. (안 장관이 6일 브리핑하려던 기본 계획에는 국군사관학교 신설 장소 외에 교육 방식 등에 대한 정부의 기본 구상도 담겨 있었던 것으로 알려졌다. 사관학교에 관심 있는 잠재적 지망생들에게는 중요한 정보인데, 이 또한 공개가 미뤄진 것이다. 구체적 방안이 발표되지 않는 가운데, 육·해·공군사관학교 총동문회는 오는 8일 국회 본관 앞에서 ‘사관학교 통폐합·육사 이전 반대 궐기대회’를 열기로 했다. 이처럼 갈등이 지속되면서 사관학교 통합 필요성에 대한 논란도 커지고 있다.)

The government argues that integrating the academies is necessary to institutionalize 'jointness'—the organic cooperation of the Army, Navy, and Air Force beyond their respective operational domains. President Lee also stated the policy of integrating the academies at the joint commissioning ceremony for new officers from the three service academies last February, saying, "In a rapidly changing security environment, close cooperation and integrated operational capabilities are essential." (정부는 육·해·공군이 각자의 작전 영역을 넘어 유기적으로 협력하는 ‘합동성’을 체질화하려면 사관학교 통합이 필요하다고 하고 있다. 이 대통령도 지난 2월 육·해·공군 사관학교 신임 장교 통합 임관식에서 사관학교 통합 방침을 밝히며 “급변하는 안보 환경에서 긴밀한 협력과 통합된 작전 수행 능력은 필수”라고 밝혔다.)

However, officers produced annually by the three service academies account for only about 10% of all commissioned officers. The vast majority of junior officers come from ROTC, Officer Candidate School, the Korea Army Academy at Yeongcheon (3rd Army Academy), and the Armed Forces Nursing Academy. Critics of integration point out, "If the goal is jointness, for consistency, these other commissioning sources should also be integrated." (하지만 육·해·공군 사관학교가 배출하는 장교는 매년 임관하는 장교의 10% 수준밖에 되지 않는다. 초급 장교의 절대다수는 학군·학사장교, 육군3사관학교, 국군간호사관학교 출신이다. 통합을 반대하는 편에서는 “합동성이 목적이라면 이들도 통합해야 논리적일 것”이라고 지적하고 있다.)

A military source reported, "There are persistent whispers that the true intention is to close down the KMA, implicated in the December 3 martial law incident, and develop the Taereung KMA site to increase housing supply." In military personnel decisions from the administration's launch last year up to last month, the promotion rate for non-KMA graduates was significantly higher than in the past. The Ministry of National Defense explains this as 'enhancing diversity', but some in the military interpret it as a trend of 'excluding KMA'. The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport announced in January a plan to develop 875,000 square meters of the Taereung Country Club military golf course site in Nowon-gu, Seoul, to supply 6,800 homes. The adjacent KMA land area is 670,000 square meters, with nearby subway stations. (군 소식통은 “12·3 계엄에 연루된 육사를 폐교하고, 태릉의 육사 부지를 개발해 주택 공급을 늘리려는 것이 ‘본심’ 아니냐는 말이 줄곧 나오고 있다”고 전했다. 지난해 정부 출범 후 지난달까지 이어진 군 인사에서는 비(非)육사 출신 진급자의 비율이 과거보다 훨씬 높았다. 국방부는 “다양성 강화”라고 설명하지만, 군 일각에서는 이를 ‘육사 배제’ 흐름으로 받아들이고 있다. 국토교통부는 지난 1월 서울 노원구의 군 골프장 태릉CC 부지 87만5000㎡를 개발해 주택 6800가구를 공급하겠다는 계획을 밝혔다. 이와 인접한 육사 면적은 67만㎡로 인근에 지하철역 등이 있다.)

item.title: Lee Meets Trump at NATO Summit (李, 나토 회의서 트럼프 만난다)
item.description:
President Lee and U.S. President Donald Trump will both attend the NATO (North Atlantic Treaty Organization) summit held in Ankara, Turkey, on July 7–8. Attention is focused on whether the two leaders will discuss pressing issues, including the Coupang problem, which has recently emerged as a point of contention between South Korea and the U.S., and the stalled schedule for the second round of discussions on the security sector of the Joint Fact Sheet between the two countries. (이재명 대통령과 도널드 트럼프 미 대통령이 7~8일 튀르키예 앙카라에서 열리는 나토(NATO·북대서양조약기구) 정상회의에 나란히 참석한다. 최근 한미 간 쟁점으로 떠오른 쿠팡 문제와 2차 회의 일정을 정하지 못하고 있는 한미 조인트 팩트시트 안보 분야 후속 협의 등의 현안이 두 정상 간에 논의될지 주목된다.)

According to the White House on the 5th (local time), President Trump will arrive in Ankara on the afternoon of the 7th, hold a summit with the host country Turkey, and attend the official NATO welcome events on the 8th. President Lee will also depart for Turkey on the 7th to attend his first NATO summit since taking office. This marks an opportunity for the two leaders to meet again about 20 days after the G7 summit held in Évian, France, on June 16–17th. (5일(현지 시각) 백악관에 따르면 트럼프 대통령은 7일 오후 앙카라에 도착해 개최국인 튀르키예와 정상회담을 하고, 8일 나토 정상 공식 환영 행사 등에 참석한다. 이 대통령도 취임 후 첫 나토 정상회의 참석을 위해 7일 튀르키예로 출국한다. 지난달 16~17일 프랑스 에비앙에서 열린 주요 7국(G7) 정상회의에 이어 약 20일 만에 다시 조우할 기회다.)

In the meantime, a dispute has escalated between South Korea and the U.S. over the Coupang issue. Following the U.S. House Judiciary Committee on the 1st, the White House released a report and statement on the 2nd asserting that the South Korean government had discriminated against Coupang. In response, South Korea’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the presidential office countered, stating that “the report unilaterally reflects only Coupang’s claims” and that “the investigation into Coupang’s personal information leak is proceeding according to law and principles without discrimination.” (그사이 한미 양국 간에는 쿠팡 문제를 놓고 공방이 이어졌다. 지난 1일 미 하원 법사위에 이어 2일 백악관이 ‘한국 정부가 쿠팡을 차별 대우했다’는 취지의 보고서와 입장을 잇달아 발표했다. 이에 우리 외교부와 청와대는 “보고서에 쿠팡 측 주장만 일방적으로 반영됐다”며 “쿠팡에 대한 개인정보 유출 수사는 차별 없이 법과 원칙에 따라 진행되고 있다”고 반박했다.)

President Lee’s first NATO summit was initially focused on “solidifying defense industry cooperation” with NATO allies. However, the Coupang issue has become a strain on South Korea-U.S. relations, making an immediate response urgent. A diplomatic source noted, “Given that the two leaders have resolved major issues in a top-down manner so far, direct communication at the summit this time could provide a clue to resolving the conflict.” (이 대통령이 취임 후 처음 참석하는 이번 나토 정상회의는 애초 나토 동맹국들과의 ‘방산 협력 본격화’에 방점이 있었다. 하지만 쿠팡 문제가 한미 관계에 악재로 작용하면서 대응이 시급해진 상황이다. 외교 소식통은 “그간 한미 정상이 ‘톱다운’ 방식으로 굵직한 현안을 풀어왔던 만큼 이번에 정상 간 직접 소통이 이뤄지면 갈등 해결의 실마리가 될 수도 있을 것”이라고 말했다.)

There are also suggestions that senior government officials accompanying the visit, including Foreign Minister Cho Hyun, may hold separate meetings with key U.S. figures. The U.S. views the Coupang issue as a violation of the agreement in the Joint Fact Sheet to “ensure that U.S. companies are not discriminated against.” This could become an obstacle to further progress on security agreements, such as South Korea’s acquisition of nuclear-powered submarines, uranium enrichment, and the right to reprocess spent nuclear fuel. In fact, the schedule for the second round of security consultations between the two countries has not been confirmed as of the 6th, a month after the first round on July 2–3. (순방에 동행하는 조현 외교부 장관 등 정부 고위 인사들이 미국 측 핵심 인사들과 별도 접촉에 나설 가능성도 제기된다. 미국은 쿠팡 문제를 ‘미국 기업이 차별당하지 않도록 보장’한다는 한미 조인트 팩트시트 상의 합의 위반으로 보고 있다. 이 때문에 한국의 원자력 추진 잠수함 도입과 우라늄 농축, 사용후핵연료 재처리 권한 확보 등의 안보 합의 후속 진전에 걸림돌이 될 수 있다. 실제 한미 간 2차 안보 협의 일정은 지난달 2~3일 1차 협의 후 한 달이 지난 6일까지 확정되지 않았다.)

item.title: "A country that clamps down on dissenting voices... Is this democracy?" (“다른 의견 냈다고 입틀어 막는 나라… 이게 민주주의냐”)
item.description:
As the revised Information and Communications Network Act, spearheaded by the Democratic Party of Korea late last year, took effect on the 7th, the People Power Party launched a full-scale offensive on the 6th, saying, "A country that clamps down on dissenting voices—is this democracy?" The leadership of the People Power Party, including Representative Jang Dong-hyuk, attended the supreme council meeting wearing black masks to highlight the unfairness of the act. The Democratic Party countered, calling it "a minimal shield to protect the public sphere and victims." (작년 말 더불어민주당 주도로 개정된 정보통신망법이 7일 시행되는 가운데 국민의힘은 6일 “다른 의견을 냈다고 ‘입틀막’하는 나라, 이게 민주주의인가“라며 총공세에 나섰다. 장동혁 대표 등 국민의힘 지도부는 정보통신망법의 부당함을 알리겠다는 취지로 검은색 마스크를 착용한 채 최고위에 참석했다. 민주당은 “공론장과 피해자를 지키기 위한 최소한의 방어막”이라고 했다.)

At the party's supreme council meeting, People Power Party Representative Jang Dong-hyuk stated, "The Information and Communications Network Act aims to shut down not only traditional legacy media but also YouTubers ahead of the (presidential) withdrawal of the indictment. History may remember July 6, 2026, as the day South Korean democracy died." The act mandates compensation of up to five times the damages for distributing false or manipulated information online through internet media and imposes fines of up to 1 billion won for malicious or repeated dissemination. Despite opposition from the opposition party and pro-government groups like the People's Solidarity for Participatory Democracy, citing violations of freedom of expression, the Democratic Party pushed it through with its majority. (국민의힘 장동혁 대표는 이날 당 최고위원회의에서 “정보통신망법은 (대통령의) 공소취소를 앞두고 기존의 레거시 언론은 물론, 유튜버들의 입까지 모두 틀어막겠다는 것”이라며 “역사는 2026년 7월 6일을 대한민국 민주주의가 사망한 날로 기억할지도 모른다”고 했다. 정보통신망법은 인터넷 언론 등 온라인상에서 ‘허위·조작 정보’를 유통하는 경우 손해액의 최대 5배까지 배상하게 하고, 악의적·반복적으로 유포한 경우 최대 10억원의 과징금을 부과하는 내용이다. 야당은 물론 참여연대 등 친여 단체도 표현의 자유 침해를 이유로 법안 처리에 반대했지만 민주당은 다수석으로 강행 처리했다.)

Chief of the Floor, Chung Jin-Suk, also remarked, "It's an irony of history that the Democratic Party, which profited handsomely from spreading false information, now claims to crack down on falsehoods while suppressing constitutionally guaranteed freedom of expression." He added, "From the Kim Dae-up screen scandal to the mad cow disease rumors, THAAD electromagnetic wave rumors, Fukushima rumors, and the recent salmon party rumors, the Democratic Party has a history of fake news incitement. If their past false and manipulated incitement had been punished under this gag law, they would have sold off their party offices just to pay compensation." The People Power Party calls for suspending enforcement and re-amending the law to remove toxic clauses. (정점식 원내대표도 이날 “허위사실 유포로 짭짤한 이익을 챙겨왔던 민주당이 이제 와 허위사실을 단속하겠다며 헌법이 보장한 표현의 자유를 억압하겠다는 것은 역사의 아이러니”라고 했다. 이어 “김대업 병풍 의혹부터 광우병 괴담, 사드 전자파 괴담, 후쿠시마 괴담, 최근 연어 술파티 괴담까지 민주당은 가짜뉴스 선동의 역사를 이어왔다”며 “그동안의 허위·조작 선동이 지금의 입틀막법 기준으로 처벌받았다면 손해배상금 납부하다 당사까지 팔았을 것”이라고 했다. 국민의힘은 시행을 유예하고 독소 조항 삭제 등을 위한 재개정에 나서자는 입장이다.)

Democratic Party spokesman Kim Sung-hoe issued a commentary stating, "The revised law is not about blocking everyday communication or legitimate criticism of power, but a targeted regulation that filters out only malicious fake news and hate speech that destroys others' lives. The People Power Party, by calling this a 'gag law' and stoking anxiety, is thinking like the original master of gagging." (민주당 김성회 원내대변인은 이날 논평을 내고 “개정된 법은 일상적인 소통이나 정당한 권력 비판을 막는 것이 아니라, 타인의 삶을 파괴하는 악의적 가짜뉴스와 혐오 표현만 골라내는 ‘핀셋’ 규제법안”이라며 “국민의힘이 이 법을 ‘입틀막법’이라고 부르며 불안을 키우고 있는데, 입틀막당의 원조다운 발상”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: "Permanent Ban on Rejoining for Those Engaged in Serious Party-Disruptive Acts" (장동혁 “해당 행위자 복당 영구 금지”)
item.description:
The Central Ethics Committee of the People Power Party held a plenary session on the 6th to deliberate on disciplinary requests against dozens of lawmakers. People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk stated during the party’s closed-door meeting that day, “For serious party-disruptive acts, even if it means amending the party constitution and rules, rejoining must be permanently banned.” (국민의힘 중앙윤리위원회가 6일 전체회의를 열고 의원 수십 명에 대한 징계 요구안을 심의했다. 장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 이날 당 비공개 회의에서 “심각한 해당 행위에 대해선 당헌·당규를 개정해서라도 복당을 영구 금지해야 한다”고 했다.)

The Ethics Committee reviewed approximately 70 disciplinary requests submitted by party members before and after the June 3 local elections. A party official said, “I understand the meeting concluded with confirming and organizing the disciplinary proposals.” This indicates that the process of determining whether to discipline specific individuals has not yet begun. (윤리위는 이날 6·3 지방선거 전후로 당원 등이 제출한 징계 요구안 약 70여 건을 검토했다. 당 관계자는 “징계안을 확인하고 정리하는 선에서 회의를 마친 것으로 알고 있다”고 했다. 특정인에 대한 징계 여부를 가리는 절차를 시작하진 않았다는 의미다.)

However, the convening of the Ethics Committee has sparked speculation that it may be targeting certain individuals within the party. Those mentioned as potential disciplinary targets include about a dozen lawmakers from the so-called “pro-Han” faction who supported independent candidate Han Dong-hoon over the People Power Party’s candidate Park Min-sik in the June by-election for the Buk-gu district of Busan. It is also reported that a disciplinary request has been submitted against 25 lawmakers belonging to the party’s internal group “Alternatives and Future,” who have publicly called for Leader Jang’s resignation. (다만 윤리위가 소집되자 당내 특정 인사의 징계를 염두에 둔 것 아니냐는 말이 나온다. 징계 대상으로는 지난 6월 부산 북구갑 국회의원 보궐선거에서 국민의힘 박민식 후보가 아닌 무소속 한동훈 후보를 도운 이른바 친한계 의원 10여 명이 거론된다. 장 대표의 사퇴를 공개 요구해 온 당내 모임 ‘대안과 미래’ 소속 의원 25명에 대한 징계 요청서도 올라가 있는 것으로 전해졌다.)

Ethics Committee Chairman Yoon Min-woo (a professor of police administration at Gachon University) had previously voted to expel lawmaker Han Dong-hoon and to discipline pro-Han lawmakers Bae Hyun-jin and former Supreme Council member Kim Jong-hyuk. The disciplinary actions against Bae and Kim were halted after a court accepted their requests for a temporary injunction. (윤민우 윤리위원장(가천대 경찰행정학과 교수)은 앞서 한동훈 의원 제명, 친한계인 배현진 의원, 김종혁 전 최고위원 징계를 의결했었다. 배 의원과 김 전 최고위원 징계는 법원이 효력 정지 가처분 신청을 받아들여 제동이 걸렸다.)

People Power Party Senior Spokesperson Park Seong-hoon reported that Leader Jang Dong-hyuk stated during the closed-door meeting that morning, “To respect the will of party members and preserve the party’s continuity, disciplinary action against those who commit serious party-disruptive acts is inevitable.” This remark was reportedly made in reference to suspicions that some People Power Party-affiliated district and county council members colluded with the Democratic Party during the election of district and county council speakers. (장동혁 대표는 이날 오전 비공개 회의에서 “당원의 의사를 존중하고 당의 영속성을 (지키기) 위해서 심각한 해당 행위자에 대한 징계가 불가피하다”고 밝혔다고 박성훈 국민의힘 수석대변인이 전했다. 일부 국민의힘 소속 시·군·구 의원이 시·군·구 의장 선출 과정에서 더불어민주당과 결탁했다는 의혹을 언급하면서 한 발언이라고 한다.)

Nevertheless, the fact that this statement was made on the day the Ethics Committee met regarding lawmakers has led to interpretations that it may be targeting pro-Han factions. In response, Senior Spokesperson Park told reporters, “When there is a candidate from our party, supporting an independent candidate is not a one-time occurrence. This is not something to be interpreted in connection with specific factions, individuals, or political advantages or disadvantages, but rather concerns party principles and discipline.” (다만 국회의원에 대한 윤리위가 열리는 날 나온 발언이라는 점에서 친한계 등을 겨냥한 것 아니냐는 해석도 있다. 이에 대해 박 수석대변인은 기자들과 만나 “우리 당 소속 후보가 있음에도 불구하고 무소속 후보를 지원하고 이런 행위가 단 한 번이 아니지 않으냐”며 “특정 계파나 특정인, 정치적 유불리와 결부해 해석할 수 있는 부분이 아니라 당의 원칙과 기강에 관한 것”이라고 했다.)

Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon told reporters that day, “It seems they intend to target not the pro-Han faction but the ‘anti-Jang faction’ (anti-Jang Dong-hyuk faction) across the board.” A two-term lawmaker mentioned as a potential disciplinary target said, “If they push through a mass disciplinary action, it will only amplify calls for Leader Jang’s resignation.” Pro-leadership Supreme Council member Kim Jae-won also stated in an interview with BBS Radio that day, “If disciplinary actions cause further confusion and draw public criticism, they will fail to achieve their purpose.” (무소속 한동훈 의원은 이날 기자들과 만나 “친한계가 아니라 반장계(반장동혁계) 모든 사람을 대상으로 징계하려는 것 같다”고 했다. 징계 대상으로 거론된 한 재선 의원은 “무더기 징계를 밀어붙인다면 장 대표 사퇴론만 커질 것”이라고 했다. 당권파 김재원 최고위원도 이날 BBS라디오 인터뷰에서 “징계로 인해 오히려 혼란이 야기되고 국민 비판을 받게 된다면 징계 목적을 달성할 수 없다”고 했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok Declares Candidacy by Targeting Chung Cheong-rae... Pro-Chung Faction Calls It a "Blame-Shifting Declaration" (김민석, 정청래 때리며 출마 선언… 친청 “남탓 선언”)
item.description:
The race for the Democratic Party's leadership has officially begun as former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok became the first among the party's power contenders to declare his candidacy for the August 17th national convention on the 6th. On this day, Kim targeted his rival, former Representative Chung Cheong-rae, stating, "Over the past year, the harm of 'self-centered politics' has plunged party-government cooperation into chaos." In response, figures from the pro-Chung camp fired back in unison, saying, "A declaration of candidacy that only blames others and criticizes like this is deplorable." (김민석 전 국무총리가 6일 더불어민주당 당권 주자 중 처음으로 8·17 전당대회 출마를 선언하며 민주당 당권 경쟁이 본격 시작됐다. 김 전 총리는 이날 경쟁자인 정청래 전 대표를 겨냥해 “지난 1년간 ‘자기 정치’의 폐해가 당정 협력을 혼선에 빠뜨렸다”고 했다. 이에 대해 정 전 대표 측 인사들은 “이렇게 남 탓만 하고 비난하는 식의 출마 선언은 개탄스럽다”며 일제히 견제구를 날렸다.)

Kim held two press conferences to declare his candidacy on this day—one in the morning in Gwangju, South Jeolla Province, and another in the afternoon in Seoul—directly attacking Chung. Referring to issues such as the failed push for a merger with the Fatherland Innovation Party spearheaded by Chung, the fiercely pursued prosecution reform that sparked conflict with the presidential office, and the nomination process for the June 3rd local elections, Kim said, "A lack of deliberation, insufficient debate, procedural flaws, and a lack of consistency have created many problems." Kim's mention of "self-centered politics" was interpreted as implying that during Chung's tenure as party leader, the ruling party pursued one-sided politics catering to hardline supporters rather than supporting government policies. (김 전 총리는 이날 오전 전남광주, 오후 서울에서 두차례 출마 기자회견을 열고 정 전 대표를 직격했다. 그는 정 전 대표가 추진했다가 무산된 조국혁신당과의 합당 문제, 밀어붙이다 청와대와 갈등을 일으킨 검찰 개혁 문제, 6·3 지방선거 공천 과정 등을 언급하며 “숙의 부족과 토론 부족, 절차 미비와 일관성 부족은 많은 문제를 낳았다”고 했다. 김 전 총리가 ‘자기 정치’를 언급한 것은 정 전 대표 재임 당시 여당이 정부 정책 등을 뒷받침하기보다는 강성 지지층 중심의 일방 정치를 해왔다는 뜻으로 해석됐다.)

He added, "At this rate, both the success of state affairs and party unity will be difficult." He also warned, "At this historic juncture, the party must not become a 'burden on state affairs,'" and "If we are not strict now, we could fall into the quagmire of defeat in the general election." Pro-Moon lawmaker Kang Deok-gu said in a media interview on the same day, "If Chung becomes leader, the president will become a lame duck, and if he doesn't, his political career ends. The way to resolve this is for Chung to not run, isn't it? It might be wise for him to sit this one out." (그는 “이대로는 국정 성공도, 당의 단합도 어렵다”고 했다. 그러면서“역사적 시점에 당이 ‘국정의 짐’이 돼선 안 된다”며 “지금 엄격하지 않으면 우리는 총선 패배의 늪으로 빠져들 수 있다”고도 했다. 친명계 강득구 의원은 이날 언론 인터뷰에서 “정 전 대표가 되면 대통령이 레임덕이 오고, 정 전 대표가 안 되면 그의 정치인생이 끝나면 이것을 풀 수 있는 방법은 정 전 대표가 나오지 말아야 하는 것 아닌가”라며 “이번에 불출마하는 게 지혜일 수 있다”고 했다.)

Kim chose the Jeonil Building 245 in Dong-gu, Gwangju—a site where civilian forces engaged with martial law troops during the May 18 Democratic Uprising in 1980—as the venue for his candidacy declaration. In this convention, the "one delegate, one rights-member, one vote" system, championed by Chung, will be applied for the first time, and the support of Honam, the Democratic Party's stronghold, is expected to play a decisive role. Later, at his candidacy press conference held in the National Assembly in Seoul, Kim was joined by about a dozen incumbent lawmakers, including Lee Geon-tae and Park Seong-joon, who declared their candidacy for the supreme council election. (김 전 총리는 이날 5·18 광주민주화운동 당시 시민군이 계엄군과 교전한 곳인 동구 전일빌딩245을 출마 선언 장소로 선택했다. 이번 전당대회에선 정 전 대표가 주도한 ‘대의원·권리당원 1인 1표제’가 처음 적용돼 민주당 텃밭인 호남 표심이 결정적인 역할을 할 전망이다. 이후 서울 국회에서 연 출마 회견에는 최고위원 선거 출마를 선언한 이건태, 박성준 의원 등 현역 의원 10여명이 함께했다.)

The pro-Chung faction escalated their criticism by openly bringing up Kim's absence from the vote to lift the martial law declaration during the December 3 emergency martial law incident, as well as the "Candidate Unification Committee (CUCS) incident" during the 2002 presidential election, when Kim defected from the Democratic Party to support candidate Chung Mong-joon. Lawmaker Lee Seong-yoon, in a Facebook post, demanded that Kim explain why he did not participate in the vote to lift martial law on the day of the declaration. Kim had previously claimed in a Facebook post on December 4, 2024, the day after the martial law declaration, that he "fell asleep after taking cold medicine due to overwork and was late for the vote." In response, Lee asked, "What were the ingredients of that cold medicine?" (친청계는 12·3 비상계엄 당시 김 전 총리의 국회 해제 표결 불참, 2002년 대선 당시 민주당을 탈당해 정몽준 후보로 옮겨갔던 ‘후단협(후보 단일화 협의회) 사태’ 등을 공개 거론하며 비판 수위를 높였다. 이성윤 의원은 페이스북 글에서 계엄 당일 김 전 총리가 국회 해제 결의안 표결에 불참한 경위를 해명하라고 했다. 김 전 총리는 계엄 다음 날인 2024년 12월 4일 페이스북 글에서 “(계엄 당일) 과로로 감기약을 먹고 잠들었다가 (표결에) 늦었다”고 했었다. 이에 대해 이 의원은 “감기약 성분이 무엇이냐”고도 물었다.)

In response, Kim said on CBS Radio, directed at Lee, "He probably owes me an apology." Kim added, "Because he made false statements, he's going to be in a difficult spot. How can someone who studied law and comes from the prosecution act like that?" (그러자 김 전 총리는 CBS 라디오에서 이 의원을 향해 “아마 저한테 사과해야 할 것”이라고 했다. 김 전 총리는 “허위사실을 말씀하셨기 때문에 좀 곤란해지시겠다”며 “어떻게 법을 하고 검찰 출신인 분이 저렇게 하나”라고 했다.)

Lawmaker Han Min-soo, a former chief of staff for Chung, also criticized Kim. Regarding Kim's claim that Chung's leadership had "caused confusion," Han said, "As the first prime minister of the Lee Jae-myung administration, Kim oversaw the entire cabinet and government operations. He must provide a clear and responsible answer to the public and party members regarding his irresponsible and self-contradictory remarks." Lawmaker Choi Min-hee also asked, "Honestly, didn't Kim defect from the Democratic Party 'to facilitate candidate unification with Chung Mong-joon'?" In response, pro-Moon lawmaker Lee Geon-tae said, "Dragging up the CUCS from 25 years ago shows he's really desperate." Lawmakers Lee Seong-yoon, Han Min-soo, and Choi Min-hee are all considered strong potential candidates for the upcoming supreme council election. (정 전 대표 비서실장 출신인 한민수 의원도 김 전 총리를 비판했다. 그는 정 전 대표 지도부가 ‘혼선을 초래했다’는 김 전 총리 발언에 대해 “이재명 정부의 초대 국무총리로서 내각과 정부 운영 전반을 총괄해 온 당사자”라며 “무책임하고 자기 모순적인 발언에 대해 국민과 당원 앞에 분명하고 책임 있는 답을 내놓아야 할 것”이라고 했다. 최민희 의원도 “정직하게 말하면 김 전 총리는 ‘정몽준으로의 후보 단일화를 위해’ (민주당을) 탈당한 것 아니냐”고 했다. 이에 친명계 이건태 의원은 “25년 전 후단협까지 끌고 오는 걸 보니 정말 다급한 모양”이라고 했다. 이성윤, 한민수, 최민희 의원은 모두 친청계로 이번 최고위원 선거 출마를 유력 고려하고 있다.)

Another power contender, lawmaker Song Young-gil, is also expected to declare his candidacy shortly. He was spotted on this day in the National Assembly's National Defense Committee plenary session holding a document titled "Song Young-gil's Declaration of Candidacy for Party Leader." When asked by reporters about the theme of his upcoming declaration, Song replied, "It's solely about the 2030 generation (the 20s and 30s)," adding, "Without the support of the 2030 generation, there is no election in 2030 (for the next presidential race)." (또다른 당권 주자인 송영길 의원도 조만간 출마 선언을 할 예정이다. 그는 이날 오후 국회 국방위원회 전체회의에서 ‘송영길 당대표 출마선언문’이란 제목의 문건을 들고 있는 모습이 포착되기도 했다. 송 의원은 이날 기자들을 만나 출마 선언의 주제를 묻는 질문에 “오로지 2030(세대)”라며 “2030(지지) 없이는 2030(차기) 대선은 없다”고 했다.)

item.title: Following 'Scary-no' Controversy, Now '5 Minutes 23 Seconds'... Cho Kuk Ignites Ilbe Debate (‘무섭노’ 이어 이번엔 ‘5분 23초’… 조국이 불지핀 일베 논란)
item.description:
Cho Kuk, former leader of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, argued that ending a question with 'no' is a hateful expression and should not be used. This is because it is used in some online communities to mock the late former President Roh Moo-hyun. In response, online reactions included comments like, "So are you going to ban 'Nee-geu a-bu-ji mwo ha-si-no' (a line from the movie 'Friend')?" and "Representative Cho, why are you doing this?" (조국 조국혁신당 전 대표가 의문문 끝을 ‘노’로 끝내는 표현을 놓고 “혐오 표현이므로 사용하지 말아야 한다”고 주장했다. 일부 인터넷 커뮤니티에서 고(故) 노무현 전 대통령을 조롱하는 표현으로 쓰인다는 이유다. 그러자 온라인을 중심으로 “‘느그 아부지 뭐 하시노(영화 ‘친구’ 대사)’도 금지시킬 셈이냐” “조 대표님 와 그라노” 같은 반응이 이어졌다.)

The controversy began on the 5th when a female idol group member in her 20s from Geoje, South Gyeongsang Province, said "scary-no" on a YouTube broadcast. Cho pointed out the possibility that this might be an expression from 'Ilgan Best' (Ilbe, a far-right online community), arguing that it is not a Gyeongsang dialect but a hateful expression. He stated, "From my observation, Ilbe mechanically attaches 'no' to standard language. In the Yeongnam dialect, 'na' and 'no' are used distinctly in interrogative sentences." <<> On the 6th, Lee Jun-seok, leader of the Reform Party, commented, "It forces the younger generation to handle history with emotions like you do," and added, "I hope you don't make the word 'no,' which is a Gyeongsang dialect ending, into something to be avoided like a taboo." Na Kyung-won, a lawmaker from the People Power Party, wrote on Facebook, "It feels like watching totalitarian Red Guards," and added, "A censorship society where you can't even freely use dialects... South Korea is becoming that. Scary-no." (논란은 경남 거제 출신 20대 여성 아이돌 그룹 멤버가 유튜브 방송에서 “무섭노”라고 발언한 것을 놓고 조 전 대표가 5일 ‘일간베스트’(일베·극우 성향 온라인 커뮤니티)식 표현일 가능성을 지적하며 시작됐다. 경상도 사투리가 아니라 혐오 표현이라는 취지다. 그러면서 “나의 관찰로는 일베는 표준말 뒤에 기계적으로 ‘노’를 붙여 사용한다. 영남말 의문문에서 ‘나’와 ‘노’는 구별돼 사용된다”고 했다.)

In response to such criticism, Cho wrote on Facebook on the 6th, saying, "I completely disagree with the criticism that this is 'acting like a bossy elder nagging the 10s and 20s'" and stated, "We must clearly inform that this is a wrongful act of mocking and belittling the late President Roh Moo-hyun." On the same day, Cho shared on Facebook an article about a pro-government YouTube channel's claim that the line '5 minutes 23 seconds' from a famous cartoon evokes the date of Roh's passing (May 23), and commented, "The reason for using '5.23' is questionable." <<> In online communities popular among younger generations, reactions were rife with criticism and mockery of Cho, such as "Please also ban 'Americano'" and "Let's remove singer Kang San-eh's song 'Wa Geu-ra-no' from karaoke." Pro-government communities even saw posts expressing concerns like, "I worry that because of former leader Cho, young people might end up defending Ilbe in reverse." (개혁신당 이준석 대표는 6일 “젊은 세대에게 본인들처럼 감성으로 역사를 다루라고 강요하는 것”이라며 “경상도 사투리 끝말인 ‘노’라는 글자를 피휘(避諱·왕 이름에 쓰인 한자를 피하는 것)하게 만들지 않으면 좋겠다”고 했다. 국민의힘 나경원 의원도 페이스북에서 “전체주의 홍위병들을 보는 듯하다”며 “사투리도 마음대로 못 쓰는 검열 사회, 남조선이 돼가노. 무섭노”라고 했다.)

item.title: Lee Byung-tae, Who Made 'May 18' Remarks, Resigns Following Blue House Recommendation (‘5·18 발언’ 이병태, 靑 권고에 결국 자진사퇴)
item.description:
Lee Byung-tae, deputy chairman of the Presidential Regulatory Reform Committee, who criticized that "May 18 has become a sacred cow," resigned on the 6th. This followed the Blue House's recommendation on the same day that "the matter is very serious," urging his resignation. It came four days after Lee posted a Facebook message on the 2nd criticizing the heavy disciplinary action against Baejae High School's baseball team for singing a "Starbucks cheer song." (“5·18이 성역이 됐다”고 비판한 이병태 대통령 직속 규제합리화위원회 부위원장이 6일 사퇴했다. 청와대가 이날 “사안이 매우 엄중하다”며 사퇴를 권고한 데 따른 것이다. 이 부위원장이 지난 2일 페이스북에 ‘스타벅스 응원가’를 부른 배재고 야구부 중징계를 비판한 글을 올린 지 나흘만이다.)

Blue House spokesperson Kang Yu-jeong announced in a notice that day, "Deputy Chairman Lee has expressed his intention to resign, and the Blue House has decided to accept it." Earlier, the Blue House had publicly recommended Lee's resignation that day. The Blue House stated, "As a key member appointed to a presidential committee with significant responsibility and authority, we emphasized the need to align with the government's policy direction and issued a warning measure. Subsequently, due to the seriousness of the matter, we recommended Deputy Chairman Lee's resignation." It added, "The Lee Jae-myung administration will continue efforts toward inclusion, expanding beyond conservatives and progressives." (청와대 강유정 대변인은 이날 공지를 통해 “이 부위원장이 사퇴 의사를 전했고 청와대는 이를 수용하기로 했다”고 밝혔다. 이에 앞서 청와대는 이날 공개적으로 이 부위원장에게 사퇴를 권고했다. 청와대는 “책임과 권한이 큰 대통령 직속 위원회에 임명된 주요 구성원으로서 정부의 국정 기조에 부합하기 위해 노력해야 함을 강조하고 경고 조치를 시행했다”며 “이후 사안이 매우 엄중한 까닭에 이 부위원장의 사퇴를 권고했다”고 밝혔다. 이어 “이재명 정부는 보수와 진보를 넘어 외연을 확장하는 포용의 노력을 지속해 나갈 것”이라고 덧붙였다.)

Deputy Chairman Lee wrote on Facebook that day, "Judging that I should not burden the appointing authority and the government, and following the recommendation for voluntary resignation, I have decided after much deliberation to step down from the deputy chairman position. Although I am stepping down under the guise of voluntary resignation, I will continue to live dreaming of a truly free nation for both individuals and businesses." He added, "We all have sacred grounds. But society should not force one's own or a group's sacred grounds onto others." He continued, "Especially, it is the essence of democracy that power does not force this. When power and groups arbitrarily define the boundary between freedom and indulgence, that is the beginning of totalitarianism." (이 부위원장은 이날 페이스북에 “임명권자와 정부에 부담을 주어서는 안 된다는 판단과 자진 사퇴 권고에 따라, 고심 끝에 부위원장 직을 내려놓기로 결정했다”며 “저는 비록 자진 사퇴의 형식을 빌려 물러나지만, 앞으로도 개인과 기업 모두가 진정으로 자유로운 나라를 꿈꾸며 살아가겠다”고 썼다. 그러면서 “우리 모두에게 성역은 있다. 하지만 자신과 일부 집단의 성역을 타인에게 강요하는 사회가 되어서는 안 된다”고 했다. 이어 “특히 권력이 이를 강요하지 않는 것이 민주주의의 본질”이라며 “자유와 방종의 경계마저 권력과 집단이 자의적으로 정의하기 시작하면 그것이 바로 전체주의의 시작”이라고 했다.)

The controversy began when Baejae High School was suspended from competition for six months for mocking the May 18 Democratization Movement by shouting phrases like "Let's go to Starbucks" and "Tank Day" toward Gwangju Il High School. Deputy Chairman Lee then posted a Facebook message on the 2nd saying, "May 18 has become a sacred cow" and "It resembles North Korea." Prior to this, he had also faced criticism within the ruling party for posts about the president-led Honam semiconductor complex and other mega projects, claiming that "actual investment will be difficult" and that "the 'moment of truth' will come at the end of the administration." <<> Within the ruling party, there were calls for the resignation of Deputy Chairman Lee, who is considered centrist-conservative, with claims that he "does not fit the Democratic Party administration." Leadership within the Democratic Party also criticized him, urging an apology and resignation. The argument was that "by shielding the perpetrator by calling the May 18 mockery incident a sacred cow or comparing it to North Korea, he effectively threw away his qualifications as a public official under the Lee Jae-myung administration." (이번 논란은 배재고가 광주일고를 향해 ‘스타벅스 가야지’ ‘탱크데이’ 등을 외쳐 5·18 민주화 운동을 조롱했다는 이유로 6개월 출전 정지를 받은 가운데, 이 부위원장이 지난 2일 “5·18이 성역이 됐다” “북한의 모습”이라는 페이스북 글을 쓰면서 시작됐다. 이에 앞서 그는 대통령이 주도한 호남 반도체 산단 등 메가 프로젝트에 대해서도 “실제로 투자는 어려울 것”이라며 “정권 말 ‘진실의 순간’ 올 것”이라는 글을 올려 여권 내 비판을 받던 상황이었다.)

However, Deputy Chairman Lee subsequently posted three more Facebook messages, including one stating, "Even shouting 'Long live Kim Il-sung' should be allowed," indicating no intention to resign. Even on the 5th, the day after the Blue House issued a stern warning, Lee told this newspaper in a phone call, "It's a statement based on my personal convictions, so my thoughts remain unchanged," rejecting calls for an apology and resignation. The position of presidential committee deputy chairman is a cabinet-level post with a guaranteed two-year term, and dismissal is possible only if the individual voluntarily expresses intent to resign. It is a position the president cannot arbitrarily remove. However, Lee appears to have been unable to withstand the ongoing resignation demands from the Blue House and the Democratic Party. In fact, in a phone call with this newspaper on the 5th, Lee said, "This is a position with a guaranteed two-year term. On what grounds are they asking me to resign?" while also adding, "If the appointing authority (the president) wants it, I can resign at any time." <<> The background to the Blue House and Democratic Party's pressure on Deputy Chairman Lee to resign is linked to the August party convention. If they kept the centrist-conservative Lee, it would clearly provoke backlash from hardline supporters. President Lee Jae-myung had previously tried to bring Lee, known as "New Lee Jae-myung," into his presidential campaign but failed due to internal opposition, before appointing him to the cabinet-level position in March. Even then, hardline lawmakers openly demanded the revocation of his appointment, saying, "He's a person with a different color from the Democratic Party." A Democratic Party official said, "The leadership contest between former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok and former leader Jeong Cheong-rae, both party power contenders, is spreading into a battle between New Lee Jae-myung and hardline supporters. If Deputy Chairman Lee, as 'New Lee Jae-myung,' was kept in place for reasons like 'expanding the base,' former Prime Minister Kim would inevitably bear that burden." (여권에선 중도·보수 성향의 이 부위원장이 “민주당 정권에 어울리는 사람이 아니다”라며 사퇴 요구가 쏟아졌다. 민주당 지도부에서도 이 부위원장에 대한 비판과 함께 사과 및 사퇴를 촉구하는 발언이 나왔다. “5·18 조롱 사태를 두고 성역이니 북한이니 하며 가해자를 감싼 것은 이재명 정부 소속 공직자의 자격을 스스로 내던진 것”이란 주장이다.)

item.title: Lee: "Companies Worried About Power Supply"... Considering New Nuclear Plants and Dams in Honam Region (李 “기업들 전력 걱정”… 호남 원전·댐 추가 검토)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, while chairing the "Three Major Mega Projects" public-private joint review meeting held at the presidential office on the 6th, repeatedly mentioned issues of electricity and water supply for establishing the Honam semiconductor cluster. However, he did not specify concrete measures for securing power and water. (이재명 대통령은 6일 청와대에서 열린 ‘3대 메가 프로젝트’ 민관합동 점검회의를 주재하면서 호남 반도체 클러스터 조성을 위한 전력, 용수 문제를 여러 차례 언급했다. 다만 구체적인 전력, 용수 확보 방안에 대해선 언급하지 않았다.)

President Lee stated, "If infrastructure such as electricity and water is established, other companies could move in," adding, "Instead of waiting for all other procedures to finish, it would be good to secure them preemptively, assuming they will happen." This amounted to an order for "speed-focused" efforts to build electricity and water infrastructure. He emphasized that beyond Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, power and water infrastructure is crucial for other large corporations and semiconductor materials, parts, and equipment partner companies. President Lee stressed, "Power will particularly be an issue, and I emphasize that swift resolution is most important." <<> President Lee also noted, "Companies say there is plenty of renewable energy, but they are very worried that baseload power might become a problem," adding, "It would be good to preemptively resolve concerns about baseload power as well." Since semiconductor production lines require a stable 24/7 power supply, there are strong concerns that in the Honam region, which relies heavily on renewable energy, there may be a shortage of economical and sustainable baseload power. This was interpreted as an allusion to the need for new nuclear power plants in the area. <<> Earlier, at a public report meeting held in Gwangju on the 30th of last month, Samsung Electronics Vice Chairman Jeon Young-hyun publicly stated to President Lee, "Please actively promote the expansion of nuclear power to compensate for the intermittency of renewable energy, as well as PPA (Power Purchase Agreements), and once again ask that LNG (liquefied natural gas) cogeneration be pursued without fail." Industry estimates suggest the power required for normal operation of the project amounts to 30 GW, equivalent to 20 nuclear reactors. <<> The government is considering utilizing additional tax revenue generated by the semiconductor boom for constructing infrastructure such as power and water facilities. President Lee said, "Since there is a significant surplus of tax revenue from the semiconductor industry, we will provide all support, including financial aid," and "We promise to preemptively and swiftly resolve all difficult issues." <<> Presidential Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik said in a media interview that day, "If necessary, we will also review existing energy policies that were negative toward new nuclear plant construction," adding, "For nuclear plants already scheduled for construction, it usually takes 7 to 9 years; we need to discuss how to shorten that period." Climate and Energy Minister Kim Sung-hwan also stated on the 3rd, "I have been informed that there are sites at Hanbit Nuclear Power Plant in Yeonggwang, South Jeolla Province, where two more reactors could be built, and also sites in Ulju where two additional reactors could be added." This indicates that the government is reviewing the construction of four new nuclear reactors. This marks a shift from the earlier stance that a mix of Hanbit nuclear power and renewable energy alone would be sufficient for stable power supply. <<> However, strong anti-nuclear sentiment in the Honam region, including South Jeolla Province, poses a variable. Resident opposition could lead to the cancellation or delay of new nuclear plant construction. Hanbit previously attempted to build Units 7 and 8, but the plans were scrapped due to resident opposition. Additionally, even if construction of new nuclear plants is decided, it takes 9 to 10 years to complete. A government official said, "It is understood that measures to simplify and expedite procedures for nuclear plant construction are being reviewed." <<> The Honam region is considered vulnerable to drought, making industrial water supply critical. The government is known to be taking the position that it may consider constructing additional dams if necessary. <<> Meanwhile, in response to criticism from opposition lawmakers and local government heads who called the Honam semiconductor project "regionally discriminatory" and "unrealistic," President Lee said, "Is it right for public officials entrusted with running the country to take such an attitude?" and "Either criticize on the premise that it's impossible, or point out imbalances on the premise that it's possible—just pick one." He added, "In any case, I hope they won't obstruct things this way." (이 대통령은 “전력, 용수 같은 인프라가 갖춰지면 다른 기업들이 들어올 수도 있다”며 “다른 절차가 다 끝날 때까지 기다릴 게 아니라 당연히 되는 걸 전제로 선제적으로 확보하면 좋겠다”고 했다. 전력·용수 인프라 구축을 위한 ‘속도전’을 주문한 것이다. 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스 외에 다른 대기업이나 반도체 소부장(소재·부품·장비) 협력업체 등을 위해서라도 전력과 용수 인프라가 중요하다는 것이다. 이 대통령은 “특히 전력이 문제가 될 텐데, 빠른 해결이 가장 중요하다는 점을 강조 말씀드린다”고 했다.)

item.title: Flat Land Three Times the Size of Yeouido, Adjacent to KTX Station… No Land Compensation Issues as It’s State-Owned Land (여의도 3배 평지, KTX 역과 인접… 국유지라 토지보상 문제 없어)
item.description:
The Gwangju military airfield site, selected by the presidential office on the 6th, is considered advantageous due to being state-owned land, effectively eliminating land compensation issues. It lies within a straight-line distance of less than 2 km from Gwangju Songjeong Station served by KTX, and is also close to the Honam Expressway. However, the military airfield must be relocated to Muan International Airport in South Jeolla Province, and obtaining consent from residents of Muan County presents a challenge. <<> ◇Government Decided in Joint Discussion with Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix <<> Working-level officials from Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are known to have inspected the Advanced 3rd District and the military airfield site, reviewing aspects such as site size, water and electricity supply conditions, and ultimately selecting the Gwangju military airfield after discussions with the government. During a briefing at the presidential office that day, Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik stated, “Companies expressed the opinion that among candidate sites in the Honam region, the Gwangju military airfield is the most suitable location,” and announced, “It has been decided to establish the Honam semiconductor industrial complex on the Gwangju military airfield site.” <<> The biggest advantage of this site is that it is a large flat area, allowing for a shorter site development period. The military airfield relocation site in Gwangsan-gu, Gwangju, spans 8.2 million square meters (approximately 2.5 million pyeong), about three times the size of Yeouido. Since semiconductor factories require precision equipment like lithography and measurement tools to operate at nanometer scales, ground stability is critical. Sites with slopes or complex terrain require more time and cost for ground improvement and foundation work. The proximity of Yongyeon Water Purification Plant near Mudeungsan Mountain, capable of high-level water treatment, is also advantageous for securing water supply. <<> An industry insider explained, “Even discovering cultural relics during factory construction can delay project schedules, but since this site is already developed, such risks are relatively low. If power and water can be supplied without issues, it’s a site where cumbersome administrative procedures can be handled relatively quickly.” The region also has the foundation to cultivate over 2,000 AI and semiconductor specialists annually, centered around institutions like the Gwangju Institute of Science and Technology (GIST), Chonnam National University, Chosun University, Korea University of Energy Technology, Jeonbuk National University, and local meister high schools. <<> ◇Airfield Relocation Expected to Take 10 Years; Muan Opposition Also a Variable <<> The challenge lies in the relocation of the Gwangju military airfield. Since the Gwangju military airfield site is state-owned, procedures like land compensation or resident relocation are virtually unnecessary. While integration and relocation to Muan International Airport are already underway, Muan County opposes it due to concerns about noise from fighter jets. A six-party meeting of the military airfield site selection committee, scheduled to be held on the 30th of last month at the Ministry of National Defense, was canceled due to Muan County Governor Kim San’s absence. <<> It is highly likely that the relocation site selection committee will reconvene as early as the end of this month to finalize Muan Airport as the relocation candidate. However, subsequent steps include a resident vote requiring the Muan County Governor to apply for hosting the military airfield. The resident vote will pass if more than one-third of eligible voters participate and a majority of valid votes are in favor. Governor Kim stated, “There is a neglect of fulfilling the three major demands while rushing toward site selection.” The three conditions set by Muan County are: prioritization of relocating Gwangju’s civilian airport to Muan International Airport, a combined 1 trillion won investment from the Special Metropolitan City of Gwangju-Jeonnam and the central government, and revolutionary national-level incentives. <<> The timeline for the military airfield relocation is also an issue. When the government, Gwangju, South Jeolla Province, and Muan agreed last December to move the Gwangju military airfield to Muan, a Gwangju city official estimated that “developing the relocation site in Muan would take about 10 years.” The Ministry of National Defense stated, “No specific timeline for relocation has been set,” but added, “Based on current assessments, we expect the relocation site selection to be completed by 2026, and site development and military airfield construction to be completed around the early to mid-2030s.” Special Metropolitan City of Gwangju-Jeonnam Mayor Min Hyeong-bae noted, “The construction period for the military airfield could be shortened to a maximum of 5 years, with costs estimated at 8-9 trillion won.” <<> The project to relocate ammunition depots in Mareuk-dong and Geumho-dong, Seo-gu, Gwangju, to the vicinity of the Gwangju military airfield is also inevitably halted if the semiconductor complex proceeds. These military airfield-related depots have long confined the area as a military facility protection zone, drawing demands for relocation from residents. The project has been pursued since 2005, with 268.1 billion won spent on land acquisition and leveling up to last year. A Ministry of National Defense official remarked, “If the site is used not as ammunition depots but for other purposes like the semiconductor industrial complex, the value of the land and groundwork will still be recognized, so the budget is not wasted.” <<> ◇U.S. Military’s Contingency Operating Base Also Needs to Move <<> The presence of a U.S. Contingency Operating Base (COB) at the Gwangju military airfield also remains a variable. A COB is a base where the U.S. military maintains only management personnel during peacetime and deploys assets and supplies during wartime. If the military airfield relocates to Muan Airport, the COB would also move there. However, when discussions of relocation arose in the past, opposition from Muan County included claims that “Muan cannot become a forward base against China.” (6일 청와대가 낙점한 광주 군 공항 부지는 국유지라 토지 보상 문제가 사실상 없다는 점이 장점으로 꼽힌다. KTX가 다니는 광주 송정역과 직선거리로 2㎞ 이내이고, 호남고속도로 등도 가까운 편이다. 다만 군 공항을 전남 무안공항으로 이전해야 하는데, 무안군 주민 동의를 얻어야 하는 게 난관이다.)

item.title: Honam Semiconductor Complex to Be Built on Gwangju Military Airport Site (호남 반도체, 광주 군공항에 짓는다)
item.description:
The presidential office announced on the 6th that, regarding the creation of a semiconductor cluster in the Honam region, which is being pursued as a key project under the "Three Mega Projects," it has decided to establish a semiconductor industrial complex on the site of the Gwangju military airport. Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix will build four semiconductor fabs (factories) on the Gwangju military airport site, investing a total of 800 trillion won. (청와대는 6일 ‘3대 메가 프로젝트’의 핵심 사업으로 추진하는 호남권 반도체 클러스터 조성과 관련해 “광주 군 공항 부지에 반도체 산업단지를 조성하기로 결정했다”고 밝혔다. 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스가 총 800조원을 투자해 만드는 반도체 팹(fab·공장) 4기를 광주 군 공항 부지에 짓겠다는 것이다.)

The presidential office disclosed the site selection results after holding a public-private joint review meeting for the mega project, chaired by President Lee Jae-myung, on the same day. Presidential Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik stated in a briefing that "the Gwangju military airport area can secure a site of approximately 2.5 million pyeong, and due to its nature as an airport, it is already leveled, minimizing the construction period for the site," also considering its proximity to downtown Gwangju and KTX station, as well as excellent logistics accessibility linked to roads, airports, and ports. (청와대는 이날 이재명 대통령 주재로 메가 프로젝트 민관 합동 점검 회의를 진행한 뒤 부지 선정 결과를 공개했다. 강훈식 대통령 비서실장은 브리핑에서 “광주 군 공항 지역은 약 250만평 규모의 부지 확보가 가능하고, 공항 특성상 이미 평탄화가 완료돼 있어 부지 공사 기간을 최소화할 수 있다는 장점이 있다”며 광주 도심, KTX역과의 인접성, 도로·공항·항만과 연계한 물류 접근성이 우수한 점도 감안했다고 밝혔다.)

However, to build a semiconductor plant in this area, the relocation of the Gwangju military airport must first take place. While an integrated relocation of the military airport and the civilian airport to Muan International Airport is currently being pursued, the consent of Muan County is required. The government has stated its intention to complete the construction of the semiconductor plant within President Lee's term, but the Ministry of National Defense indicated, "The relocation of the military airport could be completed around the early to mid-2030s." Gwangju Metropolitan Mayor Min Hyung-bae said, "The government will propose a plan to simultaneously proceed with plant construction and military airport relocation." The presidential office plans to review various methods for early relocation of the military airport within a scope that minimizes security gaps. (하지만 이 지역에 반도체 공장을 지으려면 광주 군 공항 이전이 우선 이뤄져야 한다. 현재 군 공항과 민간 공항의 무안공항 통합 이전이 추진 중이지만 무안군 동의가 필요하다. 정부는 이 대통령 임기 내에 반도체 공장 건설을 마치겠다는 입장인데, 국방부 측은 “군 공항 이전은 2030년대 초중반쯤 완료될 수 있을 것”이라고 했다. 민형배 전남광주특별시장은 “공장 건설과 군 공항 이전을 동시에 할 수 있는 방안을 정부가 내놓을 것”이라고 했다. 청와대는 안보 공백을 최소화하는 범위 내에서 군 공항 조기 이전 방법을 다각적으로 검토한다는 방침이다.)

The presidential office stated that it would announce plans for building infrastructure such as power and water supply, which are essential for semiconductor processes, after the next meeting. A ruling party official said, "If we just vacate the military airport, the site issue will be somewhat resolved, but water and power problems remain tasks to be solved." (청와대는 반도체 공정에 필수인 전력과 용수 등 인프라 구축 방안에 대해서는 다음 회의 뒤 밝히겠다고 했다. 여권 관계자는 “군 공항만 비우면 부지 문제는 어느 정도 해결되겠지만 용수나 전력 문제는 여전히 풀어야 할 숙제”라고 했다.)

Previously, President Lee said that companies were initially planning to start construction of the Honam fabs after completing the Yongin semiconductor cluster, but he personally persuaded Samsung Electronics Chairman Lee Jae-yong and SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won to secure a promise for "simultaneous execution in Yongin and Honam." Director Kang stated on the day, "Regarding Yongin, in response to companies' requests, we have decided to accelerate the overall schedule as much as possible, from land compensation to power and water supply, so that the originally planned investment of 10 fabs can proceed at a much faster pace." President Lee said on the day, "The outcome will be decided by who is faster. It's truly all about speed," adding, "The government will do the maximum it can." (앞서 이 대통령은 기업들이 용인 반도체 클러스터 조성을 끝낸 뒤에 호남의 팹 공사를 시작할 예정이었지만 이재용 삼성전자 회장, 최태원 SK그룹 회장을 직접 설득해 ‘용인·호남 동시 실행’을 약속받았다고 했다. 강 실장은 이날 “용인에 대해서는 기업들 요청에 따라 당초 계획된 팹 10기 투자가 훨씬 빠른 속도로 추진될 수 있도록 토지 보상부터 전력·용수 공급까지 전반적인 일정을 최대한 앞당기기로 했다”고 밝혔다. 이 대통령은 이날 “누가 더 빠르냐로 결판이 난다. 그야말로 오직 속도전이 중요하다”며 “정부는 할 수 있는 최대치를 할 것”이라고 했다.)
